rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The plural idols scatter attention among many objects of worship; multiplicity entails division, in which there is no good.
rows.anchor: وقال : { أوثانا } إشارة إلى تفرق الهم بكثرة المعبود , والكثرة يلزمها الفرقة ولا خير في الفرقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Across its permutations, the root وثن conveys increase and multiplicity, then division and softness or weakness; these senses are unfit for divinity.
rows.anchor: ومادة ( وثن ) بجميع تقاليبها وزاوية ويائية ومهموزة تدور على الزيادة والكثرة , ويلزمها الفرقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Arabic derivatives illustrate abundance, dispersal, and weakness: wealth grows or increases, reports spread, and the fixed thing persists through lack of power to move.
rows.anchor: واستوثن المال : سمن , فزاد لحمه , واستوثن من المال : استكثر , والنحل : صارت فرقتين

rows.speaker: أبو منصور
rows.claim: Abu Mansur distinguishes a wathn, a bodily object carved and set up for worship, from a sanam, an image without a body; al-Qazzaz transmits the distinction.
rows.anchor: قال أبو منصور : الفرق بين الوثن والصنم أن الوثن كل ما كان له جثة

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Some lexicographers instead treat wathn as synonymous with sanam.
rows.anchor: ومنهم من جعل الوثن صنما

rows.speaker: ابن عرفة
rows.claim: Ibn Arafa, quoted through al-Harawi by Abd al-Haqq, calls any image made of plaster, stone, or similar material a wathn.
rows.anchor: قال عبد الحق : قال الهروي : قال ابن عرفة : ما كان له صورة من جص أو حجارة

rows.speaker: أبو حاتم أحمد بن حمدان الرازي
rows.claim: Abu Hatim defines a sanam as a stone statue and says a human image made on a wall is also called a wathn.
rows.anchor: قال أبو حاتم أحمد بن حمدان الرازي في كتاب الزينة : الصنم تمثال من حجارة صوروا في الحائط

rows.speaker: أبو حاتم أحمد بن حمدان الرازي
rows.claim: Abu Hatim notes that Christians make images of Christ and Mary in their churches and prostrate to them.
rows.anchor: والنصارى يفعلون ذلك ويصورون في بيعهم صورة المسيح وصورة مريم ويسجدون لها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The idols' multiplicity, division, and weakness make them unfit for divine rank, so the verse uses restriction as a reversal of the polytheists' claim that they are gods.
rows.anchor: فقد تحرر أن المادة كلها دائرة على ما لا ينبغي لرتبة الإلهية من الكثرة والفرقة والرخاوة , ولذلك أتى بصيغة الحصر , وهو قصر قلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The present tense points to idol images being continually remade; people falsely call their handmade artifact a creator, a created thing a lord, and a servant an object of worship.
rows.anchor: بصيغة المضارع إشارة إلى ما يرى في كل وقت من تجدد حدوثها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ifk is something turned away from its proper truth: the fabricated objects are falsely declared divine.
rows.anchor: إفكا } أي شيئا مصروفا عن وجهه , فإنه مصنوع وأنتم تسمونه باسم الصانع

words: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لَكُمْ رِزْقًۭا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because humans always need benefit, the idols' inability to provide proves that all good belongs to God and that He alone deserves worship, refuting imagined power to benefit or harm.
rows.anchor: صرح بعجزها , وأثبت اختصاصه بالخير , لينتج اسحقاقه للعبادة دونها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The form of ابتغاء suggests exertion: God usually grants provision through effort, whether worship and reliance or ordinary worldly means; the idle should not merely indulge wishes and presume on God.
rows.anchor: وأشار بصيغة الافتعال إلى السعي فيه , لأنه أجرى عادته سبحلنه أنه في الغالب لا يؤتيه إلا بكد من المرزوق وجهد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All provision is with God; created things are ordered and interconnected so that removing any part would disorder the whole system.
rows.anchor: الرزق } اي كله , فغنه لا شيء منه إلا وهو بيده , وقد دخل فيه كل موجود , فإن الكل خلق لذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worship must be sincere and free of association; God alone merits it, rewards the worshipper, and punishes the one who turns away.
rows.anchor: واعْبدوه } اي عبادة يبلهان وهي ما كان خالصا عن الشرك , فإن من يكون كذلك يستحق ذلك ويثيب العابد له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not let outward earning distract from worship, the true means; a sin may cause a servant to lose provision.
rows.anchor: فلا يشغلكم ابتغاء الرزق بالأسباب الظاهرة عن عبادته , فإنها هي الأسباب الحقيقية , فربما حرم العبد الرزق بالذنب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Give thanks to God alone for the blessings He has bestowed.
rows.anchor: واشكروا } اي اوقعوا الشكر { له } خاصة على ما أفاض عليكم من النعم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All true authority belongs to God in this life, and people physically return after death for judgment; He can resurrect them effortlessly and reward or punish them in both abodes.
rows.anchor: إليه } أي وحده { ترجعون * } اي معنى في الدنيا والآخرة بأنه لا حكم في الحقيقة لأحد سواه , وحسا بالنشر والحشر بعد الموت

none: The segment quotes the Qurʾānic passage only and offers no separate commentary.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because the passage concerns testing, the narrative expands on a messenger without a supporter among his people or a stranger among them; Lot followed Abraham as a nephew sent to Sodom.
rows.anchor: خص بالبسط في القص من لم يكن له ناصر من قومه , أو كان غريبا منها , ولذلك أتبع الخليل عليه الصلاة والسلام ابن أخيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ولوطا means We sent Lot; إذ marks the time he promptly obeyed by addressing his people.
rows.anchor: فقال : { ولوطا } أي أرسلناه , وأشار إلى إسراعه في الامتثال بقوله : { إذ }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lot's people were Sodom's residents; after he left Abraham, settled among them, and married into the community, they became his people despite having no prior kinship with him.
rows.anchor: أهل سدوم الذين سكن فيهم وصاهرهم وانقطع إليهم فصاروا قومه , حين فارق عمه إبراهيم الخليل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fahisha is an indecency exceeding every bound of ugliness, described as though there were no comparable indecency.
rows.anchor: إنكم لتأتون الفاحشة } أي المجاوزة للحد في القبح , فكأنها لذلك لا فاحشة غيرها

words: ما سبقكم بها من أحد من العالمين
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lot says no one anywhere in creation had preceded them in this act; the wording intensifies the denial beyond all people.
rows.anchor: ثم علل كونها فاحشة استئنافا بقولهك { ما سبقكم } أو هي حال مبنية لعظيم جرأتهم على المنكر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The repeated rebuke underscores the offense of sex with men; Lot adds their other wrongs to show multiple grounds for blame and continues urging them despite their apparently hopeless corruption.
rows.anchor: ثم كرر الإنكار تأكيدا لتجاوز قبحها الذي ينكرونه فقال : { أئنكم لتأتون الرجال } إتيان الشهوة , وعطف عليها ما ضموه إليها من المناكر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They cut off the road by harming traders and passersby.
rows.anchor: وتقطعون السبيل * } أي بأذى الجلابين والمارة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A nadi is the place where people gather to converse and hear one another; it is called nadi while the group is present, but not after they leave.
rows.anchor: المكان الذي تجلسون فيه للتحدث بحيث يسمع بعضكم نداء بعض من مجلس المؤانسة , وهو ناد ما دام القوم فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Munkar covers acts condemned by revealed law, honorable conduct, and reason, even if the impropriety is slight.
rows.anchor: أي هذا الجنس , وهو ما تنكره الشرائع والمروءات والعقول , ولا تتحاشون عن شيء منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They openly commit every kind of wrong together without shame, although people ordinarily avoid even what is less than proper in company.
rows.anchor: في المجتمع الذي يتحاشى فيه الإنسان من فعل خلاف الأولى , من غير أن يستحي بعضكم من بعض

words: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابُ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In obstinacy, ignorance, and mockery, they answered the warnings by demanding God's punishment if Lot was truthful; invoking God's greatest name made their insolence worse, and the challenge was meant to provoke him.
rows.anchor: إلا أن قالوا } عنادا وجهلا واستهزاء : { ائتنا بعذاب الله } وعبروا بالاسم الأعظم زيادة في الجرأة

words: ٱئْتِنَا بِعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their phrase if you are among the truthful challenges Lot's authority to warn and seeks to inflame and provoke him.
rows.anchor: { إن كنت } أي كونا متمكنا { من الصادقين * } أي في وعيدك وإرسالك , إلهابا وتهييجا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lot turns away from his people and addresses God as his benefactor, asking for help against a powerful, corrupt people beyond his ability to resist.
rows.anchor: معرضا عنهم , مقبلا بكليته على المحسن إليه : { رب } أي أيها المحسن إلي { انصرني على القوم }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels' visit to Abraham brought Isaac's birth and Jacob as Isaac's son; their mission also meant Lot's people would be destroyed, pairing benefit to the righteous with punishment for sinners as a test.
rows.anchor: فأرسلنا رسلنا بشرى لعمه إبراهيم عليه الصلاة والسلام , ولإهلاك قوم لوط عليه الصلاة والسلام , تحقيقا لانتقامنا من المجرمين , وإنعامنا على الصالحين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The particle أن is omitted because the reported speech did not coincide with the messengers' arrival; greeting and other preliminaries came first.
rows.anchor: وأسقط ( أن ) لأنه لم يتصل المقول بأول المجيء بل كان قبله السلام والإضافة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The messengers were angels, and naming them as Our messengers honors both their persons and their mission.
rows.anchor: وعظم الرسل بقولهك { رسلنا } أي من الملائكة تعظيما لهم في أنفسهم ولما جاؤوا به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In a passage about trial and testing, the good news is summarized while the warning of destruction is spelled out.
rows.anchor: ولما كان المقام للابتلاء والامتحان , أجمل البشرى , وفصل النذري

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After greeting Abraham and heading toward Sodom, the angels answer his inquiry about their mission; their emphatic wording declares that the destruction decree is settled.
rows.anchor: بعد أن بشروه وتوجهوا نحو سدوم , جوابا لسؤاله عن خطبهم , تحقيقا لأن أهل السيئات مأخذون , وأكدوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They explicitly say its inhabitants rather than using a pronoun to specify the wicked people meant and leave Lot outside that description; the people are entrenched in wrongdoing with no prospect of return.
rows.anchor: مظهرين غير مضمرين إفهاما لأن المراد أهلها الأضلاء في ذلك , إخراجا للوط عليه السلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham stresses Lot's presence to show his nephew's standing and concern for him, establish that Lot does not merit destruction, and elicit the angels' response; he gradually moves toward an explicit request.
rows.anchor: مؤكدا تنبيها على جلالة ابن أخيه , وإعلاما بشدة اهتمامه به , وأنه ليس ممن يستحق الهلاك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham's mention of Lot among the residents implicitly asks for their exemption because Lot is far removed from the wrongdoing given as the reason for destruction.
rows.anchor: وسؤالا في الدفع عنهم بكونه فيهم , لأنه بعيد عما عللوا به الإهلاك من الظلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels say they know the people better than Abraham and emphatically assure him of Lot's rescue, stressing it because his escape seemed unlikely.
rows.anchor: نحن أعلم } أي منك { بمن فيها } أي من لوط وغيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The exception makes clear that everyone in Lot's household except his wife is saved; she remains with the sinful people in the destroyed land.
rows.anchor: ولما أفهم هذا امرأه استثنوها ليكون ذلك أنص على إجاء غيرها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lot's wife was by nature among those left behind with the sinful people, so the destruction's dust covered her face with theirs.
rows.anchor: كانت } أي جبلة وطبعا { من الغابرين * } أي الباقين في الأرض المدمرة والجماعة الفجرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The correspondence between God's report and reality is a sign for believers; contemplating the ordered benefits and immense, precisely formed heavens and earth leads true knowers to firm faith in all revelation without doubt.
rows.anchor: إن في ذلك } أي الأمر العظيم من تأملهم لمطابقة الواقع لإخباره سبحانه , فلا يخبر بشيء إلا كان الواقع منهما أو مما فيهما يطابقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet is addressed as the foremost believer so others follow; continual, reflective recitation of the all-good, truthful Qur'an deepens insight and gradually opens inexhaustible secrets.
rows.anchor: خاطب رأس أهل الإيمان لأنه أعظم الفاهمين له ليقتدي به الأتباع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Revelation is a secret impartation, and its exclusive delivery to the Prophet signals his honor.
rows.anchor: ودل على شرفه لا ختصاصه به بقوله : { أوحي إليك } إذ الوحي الإلقاء سرا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Prayer is the most fitting act of worship and organizes attention, brings presence of heart, opens the chest, and sends thought into the Qur'an's fields of knowledge.
rows.anchor: وهو ما يجمع الهم , فيحضر القلب , فينشرح الصدر , فينبعث الفكر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Prayer, when maintained with all its requirements, repeatedly restrains its practitioner from grave indecencies and even subtle wrongdoing; even refraining from abandoning prayer matters, since abandoning it is unbelief.
rows.anchor: إن الصلاة تنهى } أي توجد النهي وتجدده للمواظب على إقامتها بجميع حدودها { عن الفحشاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fahsha denotes traits whose ugliness has become extreme, while munkar includes even a slight degree of ugliness.
rows.anchor: أي الخصال التي بلغ قبحها { والمنكر } أي الذي فيه نوع قبح وإن دق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The promise that God teaches those who fear Him supports the preceding point about expanded understanding of Qur'anic knowledge.
rows.anchor: واتقوا الله ويعلمكم الله } ) 77 [ البقرة : 282 ]

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's remembrance is prayer's spirit and chief purpose: watchfulness before Him, as though seeing Him, is the true restraining force.
rows.anchor: ولما كان الناهي في الحقيقة إنما هو ذكر الله , أتبع ذلك الحث على روح الصلاة والمقصد الأعظم منها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One possible sense is that God's remembrance exceeds everything; remembering Him makes the servant wholly His, as the cited saying about remembering Him when meeting one's peer illustrates.
rows.anchor: ولذكر الله } أي ولأن ذكر المستحق لكل صفة كمال { أكبر } اي من كل شيء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author cites an unattributed saying that God's complete servant is the one who remembers Him when meeting his peer.
rows.anchor: إن عبدي كل عبدي للذي يذكرني عند لقاء قرنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, regular prayer brings remembrance, softens the heart, and illuminates the mind, so this fruitful remembrance restrains sin more effectively than prayer's direct prohibition.
rows.anchor: من واظب على الصلاة ذكر الله , ومن ذكره أوشك أن يرق قلبه , ومن رق قلبه استنار لبه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The servant's remembrance recalls God's promise to remember those who remember Him; God's remembrance of a worshipper in prayer raises and clothes the servant in immeasurable lights.
rows.anchor: كما قال تعالى { فاذكروني أذكركم } وإذا كان هذا شأن ذكر العبد لمولاه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse addresses the followers because crooked nature requires effort and training in difficult obligations; the Prophet was already purified by innate nature and wisdom washing his heart.
rows.anchor: وكان صلى الله عليه وسلم قد نزه عن ذلك كله لما جبل عليه من أصل الفطرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The word صنع suggests sustained work, indicating that establishing prayer requires practice until it becomes sound habit and a clear purpose.
rows.anchor: معبرا بلفظ الصنعة الدال على ملازمة العمل تنبيها على أن إقامة ما ذكر تحتاج إلى تمرن عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command about debating the People of Scripture is linked to the command to recite revelation; it is directed to the followers, since the Prophet is above such contentious disputation by nature.
rows.anchor: لأنه ليس في طبعه المجادلة , والمماراة والمغالبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Debate does not necessarily help faith or conviction or turn anyone from manifest error; disputatiousness can mislead ordinary people by making sophistry persuasive, breed discord, and open trials.
rows.anchor: ظنا منكم أن الجدال ينفع الدين , أو يزيد في اليقين , أو يرد أحدا عن ضلال مبين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The best way to engage the People of Scripture is to recite the revelation whose continual recitation God commanded the foremost worshipper.
rows.anchor: إلا بالتي } أي بالمجادلة التي { هي أحسن } اي بتلاوة الوحي الذي امرنا راس العابدين بإدامة تلاوته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ثم marks the surprising distance to their relapse after so many causes of guidance, or the prolonged patience the messengers showed them.
rows.anchor: أشار إليه بأداة التراخي , أو هي إشارة إلى تطاول دعار الرسل لهم احتمالهم إياهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The evildoers' final state is the worst possible one: destruction in this world and lasting punishment in the next, matching the harm they inflicted on messengers.
rows.anchor: السوأى } أي الحالة التي هي أسوأ ما يكون , وهي خسارة الأنفس بالدمار في الدنيا والخلود في العذاب في الأخرى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse names the evildoers explicitly rather than using a pronoun, generalizing them and showing their wrongdoing as the cause of the outcome.
rows.anchor: أظهر موضع الإضمار تعميما ودلالة على السبب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their worst fate came because they denied God's signs and persisted in mocking them; the signs belong to the perfect Lord and are far from deserving ridicule, warning the present audience against the same fate for mocking the Romans' promised victory.
rows.anchor: أي لأجل تكذيبهم الرسل , مستهينين { بآيات الله } أي الدلالات المنسوبة غلى الملك الأعلى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The clause about denial and mockery may be an appositive to السوأى or an explanation of it: their wrongdoing blinded them into denial and ridicule, whereas believers grow in guidance.
rows.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون هذا بدلاص من ( السوأى ) أو بيانا لها بمعنى أنهم لما أساؤوا زادتهم إساءتهم عماوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Since God originates creation, He can restore it after annihilation; explicitly stating the conclusion affects the soul and recaps the preceding proof, while the ability to repeat one's own creation is self-evident.
rows.anchor: قادر على الإعادة كما قدر على الابتداءن وكان للتصريح مع النفس حالة ليست لغيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God continually begins whatever creation He wills, as people observe, then restores it after it perishes.
rows.anchor: بدا منه ما رأيتم وهو يجدد في كل حين ما يريد من ذلك كما تشاهدون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People return to God alone: inwardly, all affairs belong to Him even when limited vision attributes them to causes, and bodily after the Resurrection.
rows.anchor: ثم إليه } أي لا إلى غيره { ترجعون * } معنى في أموركم كلها في الدنيا وإن كنتم لقصور النظر تنسبونها إلى الأسباب

rows.speaker: الجماعة
rows.claim: The general reading addresses the hearers directly with ترجعون; Abu Amr, Abu Bakr from Asim, and Rawh from Yaqub read يرجعون in third person, matching the preceding narrative, while direct address is more explicit.
rows.anchor: وقرأ أبو عمرو وأبو بكر عن عاصم وروح عن يعقوب بالياء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Calling it the Hour underscores God's power to raise it despite the vast multitude of creatures, including the great, mighty, and leading people.
rows.anchor: إشارة إلى عظيم القدرة عليها مع كثرة الخلائق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The criminals fall silent and still in despair and confusion, utterly humiliated; the imperfect verb conveys continued, renewed state.
rows.anchor: يبلس } اي يسكت ويسكن يأسا وتحيرا على غاية الذل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They attached themselves to worldly things that should have been severed because they perish, and severed ties to afterlife provisions that should be joined because they endure.
rows.anchor: الذين وصلوا من الدنيا ما من حقه أن يقطع لفنائه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In worldly disputes they used gestures, mockery, and laughter to appear victorious when opponents fell silent; now the criminals themselves are silent.
rows.anchor: وكانوا في غاية اللبس في الجدل ومعرفة كل ما يغيظ الخصم من القول والفعل والتمايل والتضاحك عند سكوت الخصم

words: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُم مِّن شُرَكَآئِهِمْ شُفَعَٰٓؤُا۟
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their supposed partners will not intercede for them; the wording humiliates them by denying the aid they claimed, though other sinners may receive intercession from martyrs, scholars, and believers.
rows.anchor: نفي النفع الموجع لهم هذا الترتيب , ويجوز أن يراد بترتيبه مع ذلك التخصيص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This rebuts their claim that these are their intercessors with God.
rows.anchor: في قولهم : ^ ( { هؤلاء شفعاؤنا عند الله } ) ^

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The denial targets the idols they specifically worshipped; other intercession occurs openly or indirectly, including the Prophet's general intercession for all creation at judgment.
rows.anchor: وأما غيرهم ممن يصح وصفه بالإجرام لكونه من أهل الشرك الخفي فقد يشفع فيه من رباه من الشهداء والعلماء

rows.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: The Prophet calls for some of his companions, but is told that he does not know what they did after him and responds that they be sent away.
rows.anchor: وقوله صلى الله عليه وسلم في ناس بأعيانهم : ( أصحابي إلي إلي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham's prayer for those who disobey him and Jesus' conditional plea for his people illustrate indirect intercession.
rows.anchor: وقول إبراهيم عليه الصلاة والسلام ^ ( { ومن عصاني فإنك غفور رحيم } ) ^

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jesus' words, If You forgive them, You are mighty and wise, also offer a veiled form of intercession.
rows.anchor: كقول عيسى عليه السلام ^ ( { وإن تغفر لهم فإنك أنت لعزيز الحكيم } ) ^

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The plural form may simply refute the polytheists' claim without implying anything about number; alternatively, it may hint that some beings they worship could intercede, directly or indirectly.
rows.anchor: وإتيانه بصيغة جمع الكثرة يمكن أن يكون لا مفهوم له , لأن مورده رد اعتقادهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They will disown their partners, denying that they regarded and worshipped them as gods, in keeping with their habitual defiance and falsehood.
rows.anchor: اي متبرئين منهم ساترين لأن يكونوا اعتقدوهم آلهة وعبدوهم
